title: Tilt Temple
description: Tilt a floating labyrinth, collect the key and guide a rolling orb to the portal across three timed stages.
controls: Hold and drag to tilt; release to brake. Collect the key, then reach the portal.

zh-CN.title: 倾斜神庙
zh-CN.description: 拖动倾斜悬浮迷宫，让小球避开陷阱、取得钥匙并进入出口，挑战三关计时星级。
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动倾斜迷宫，松手减速。先吃钥匙，再到出口。
